how_this_works: Each automated run (see the Cowork Routines) picks the first entry with status 'pending', writes the draft using ONLY facts from tools.json/comparisons.json/stacks.json for that entry's tool_ids, then flips status to 'used' and fills in used_date/used_slot. When no 'pending' entries remain, the run invents one new on-brand topic, appends it here as 'pending', and uses that instead.
